issue.title: test_macro_string_literals_avoid_xprompt_terms fails: 2268f50d79 split moved allowlisted %xprompts_enabled strings to a new test file

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic AST string scan; fails identically on a clean tree at master 3a4178b15a (2026-10-07, found during the sase-1hf landing check). Findings: `tests/history/test_continuation_replay_hydration_basic.py: string '"%xprompts_enabled:false\\n"'` and `'"% xprompts_enabled:false"'`. Root cause: 2268f50d79 (toobig split of the continuation replay hydration tests, agent toobig-7b) moved these legacy-directive literals into a new module that `_MACRO_STRING_ALLOWLIST` in tests/_macro_terminology_strings.py does not list. Fix: re-key the allowlist entries (with their existing reason) to the new file path, or remove them if the old path's entries are now stale.

issue.creation_reason: The macro terminology guard is red on master because a toobig test split moved allowlisted legacy-directive literals; found while landing sase-1hf.

evidence.note: Reproduced on master ee3a4f6787 (2026-10-08, sase-1hi landing): .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_macro_terminology.py fails test_macro_string_literals_avoid_xprompt_terms deterministically. Also proposed as a follow-up by sase-1hi.6 (note #1); not caused by Plan Decisions.

Independent repro on sase-1ig.4 tree (2026-10-09): tests/test_macro_terminology.py::test_macro_string_literals_avoid_xprompt_terms fails with a different finding than the hydration instance: tests/test_plugin_commands_mount.py: string '"xprompt"' (line 124, assert xprompt in reserved, from committed 991c8b4dd7 plugin-commands; file unmodified by this phase). Guard needs an allowlist entry or reason for the reserved-name assertion.

payload.description: Check if same macro-terminology failure is already tracked

evidence.note: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP from phase sase-1h8.13.1.9.7 (note #2), triaged by the sase-1h8.13.1.9 land agent: the phase's sase check (run 76866b1372fa463fd91c046ad05a348d, 2026-10-09) failed tests/test_macro_terminology.py::test_macro_string_literals_avoid_xprompt_terms, and it reproduced on the clean base. The land agent reproduced it again on clean master bd830064ca in sase tool run check (run 7d658c634fd39565484d98edcae94afa, triage KNOWN, possible owner sase-1hr). The finding is in tests/test_plugin_commands_mount.py, so a repair is still not on master. sase-1i5.9.1.2.1.7 holds an uncommitted repair.
